Maya: Dropping a short proposal for a 'regional-onramp' roadmap slice. Goal: make routing + multi-region isolation promiseable to Sales with clear gates and rollback playbooks. Link: https://redwood.internal/notes/regional-onramp 

Ravi: Map lanes to sell motion? pilot = self-serve, affinity = sales-assisted hosted, residency = Dedicated/Private.

Sam: Add explicit evacuation steps per lane (owner + order). Last cutover was messy.

Lina: Sales wants a 2-bullet checklist per lane and an 'isolation readiness' percent. Keep GTM language tight.

Maya: Proposed guarded gates: p95 < 300ms in-region, tracing + audit logs, documented committed capacity and fallback.

Jesse: I'll pull top customers and tag who needs affinity vs residency, share by Fri.

Ravi: Infra request: tiny policy DSL (preferred_region, failover_chain, tenant_quota). Infra owns runtime; product owns semantics/tests.

Sam: Implementation: start passive (headers + metrics), then add enforcement in pilot 2. Avoid broad migrations.

ops-bot: Task created https://tasks.internal/regional-onramp/M1 assigned Maya,Ravi,Sam due 8w from 3661122334.

Maya: Action items: Jesse customer list, Ravi+Sam DSL + rollback sketch, Lina GTM checklist, Maya consolidate PRD. Will post PRD link when ready.
